name: @openlance/aios-retrieval-engine
description: Phase 4 Stage 4 Retrieval Engine: the Runtime's operational knowledge-determination subsystem, the operational realization of the frozen Retrieval namespace. It determines the minimum sufficient, dependency-complete, authority-correct knowledge set over provided candidates (discover, select, resolve dependencies, prioritize, assemble, validate, produce result), driving the frozen @openlance/aios-retrieval model, and produces a validated result. It consumes only the frozen retrieval model and the substrate, depends on no operational service (it never reaches into memory), never loads or executes, is deterministic (no search technology), and contains no vendor knowledge (ADR-0038).
